description: Mr. Zhang asks how to customize a sofa size, fabric color, material, and delivery details.
visual_style: See style-guide.md for full consistency rules

scenes.description: Mr. Zhang asks whether the sofa can be customized.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Can this sofa be customized for my living room?
lines.zh: 这款沙发可以按我的客厅定制吗？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Yes. We can customize the size, color, fabric, and leg style.
lines.zh: 可以。我们可以定制尺寸、颜色、面料和沙发脚款式。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Good. I brought the measurements of my room.
lines.zh: 好的。我带来了房间尺寸。

scenes.description: They review the target sofa length, depth, and chaise side.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: What exact length and depth do you need?
lines.zh: 您需要的精确长度和深度是多少？

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: The sofa should be 2.6 meters long and 95 centimeters deep.
lines.zh: 沙发应该长二点六米，深九十五厘米。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Do you want the chaise on the left side or the right side?
lines.zh: 贵妃位您想放左边还是右边？

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Please put it on the right side when facing the sofa.
lines.zh: 面对沙发时，请把它放在右边。

scenes.description: Li Wei shows color swatches and explains how colors look at home.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Here are our fabric swatches. Which color matches your home?
lines.zh: 这里是我们的面料色卡。哪种颜色和您家更搭？

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: I like warm gray, but I worry it may look too dark.
lines.zh: 我喜欢暖灰色，但担心看起来太暗。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: In natural light, this warm gray looks soft and clean.
lines.zh: 在自然光下，这个暖灰色看起来柔和干净。

scenes.description: They compare fabric, leather, and performance fabric.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Which material is best for daily family use?
lines.zh: 哪种材质最适合家庭日常使用？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Performance fabric is a good choice because it resists stains and is easy to clean.
lines.zh: 功能面料是不错的选择，因为它防污且容易清洁。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Is it more expensive than regular fabric?
lines.zh: 它比普通面料更贵吗？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: It costs about ten percent more, but it lasts longer.
lines.zh: 大约贵百分之十，但使用寿命更长。

scenes.description: Li Wei explains sample approval before production.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Before production, we can send you a small fabric sample for approval.
lines.zh: 生产前，我们可以给您寄一小块面料样品确认。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: That would help. I want to check the color under my home lighting.
lines.zh: 这会有帮助。我想在家里的灯光下确认颜色。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Once you approve it, we will start production immediately.
lines.zh: 您确认后，我们会马上开始生产。

scenes.description: They confirm lead time, deposit, and final specification.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: How long does a custom order usually take?
lines.zh: 定制订单通常需要多长时间？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: The lead time is about four to six weeks after the deposit.
lines.zh: 支付定金后，交期大约四到六周。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Please write the size, right-side chaise, warm gray fabric, and lead time on the order.
lines.zh: 请在订单上写明尺寸、右贵妃、暖灰色面料和交期。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: No problem. I will double-check every detail before you sign.
lines.zh: 没问题。您签字前我会再次核对每个细节。
